about: Period maps to show under places.json, by id. 'overlay' says how each map can go on a web map: 'georeferenced' = someone has already lined it up with modern streets; 'iiif' = a free zoomable scan we can line up ourselves in Allmaps (which then serves XYZ tiles); 'picture' = cannot line up (perspective drawing), so link it from map pins instead. Researched 2026-11-16/17; the WashU and Rumsey sites blocked automated checks, so per-volume coverage and tile web addresses still need a browser check.

maps.title: Oliver & Whipple / A. Whipple & Co. fire insurance maps of St. Louis
maps.use_for: Building-by-building view of the 1868-1876 places: Fifth Street saloon, 417 Washington Avenue, Mozart Hall, Hennessy's, Theatre Comique.
maps.holder: Washington University in St. Louis, with the Missouri Historical Society (Whipple Volumes 1870-1898)
maps.notes: IIIF manifests offered on records. A 2023 WashU sprint lined up 200+ of these maps with modern streets; where the results are published is still to be found. Which volume covers which blocks is still to be checked.

maps.title: A. Whipple & Co. insurance map of St. Louis
maps.use_for: 619 Market Street block, Seventh and Market (Daly fight), Geyer Avenue lot.

maps.title: Pitzman's New Atlas of the City and County of St. Louis
maps.use_for: Lot owners city-wide and county roads (Gravois road, Eight-Mile House, Sportsman's Park area).
maps.holder: St. Louis Genealogical Society (images from the State Historical Society of Missouri)
maps.notes: Shown page by page on Google Maps with an owner-name index; some pages were still 'forthcoming' in 2024. No tile service published; the 1878 scans themselves could be lined up in Allmaps.

maps.title: Compton & Dry, Pictorial St. Louis
maps.use_for: Pictures of the actual buildings on Washington Avenue, Fifth Street and the levee.
maps.holder: Library of Congress; also David Rumsey Map Collection
maps.notes: Perspective drawing, 110 plates. Link the right plate from each pin. Leaflet viewer of the whole thing: https://github.com/nielsenjared/pictorial-st-louis. LOC image number = plate + 4 for the early plates (plate 1 = ?sp=5); IIIF images download freely, e.g. https://tile.loc.gov/image-services/iiif/service:gmd:gmd416m:g4164m:g4164sm:gpm00001:pa00026m/full/3000,/0/default.jpg (plate 22). Downtown: plate 1 (levee south of the bridge), 2 (Eads Bridge), 21 (Court House, Theatre Comique, Lindell Hotel), 22 (Fourth at Christy and Morgan, Fourth National Bank; near Hennessy's).

maps.title: Wm. C. Wilson & Bro., Map of the City of St. Louis
maps.use_for: Whole-city street map of the 1870s; north is to the right on the sheet. Used in the life-map mockup as the downtown base map.
maps.holder: State Historical Society of Missouri (Maps collection, item 193)
maps.notes: IIIF: https://digital.shsmo.org/iiif/2/Maps:193 (8800x6728). Small scale (2 in. = 1 mile), so blocks are drawn but not buildings. A hand fit against four known addresses lines up with today's streets to within about a block.

maps.title: R. P. Studley, Map of St. Louis and Environs, 1870
maps.use_for: Regional view with the Mississippi islands (Cabaret, Chouteau and others) as they were when the fights were held.
maps.holder: State Historical Society of Missouri (Maps collection, item 196)

maps.title: Rand, McNally & Co. map of St. Louis (Indexed Atlas of the World)
maps.use_for: Whole-city base layer for the 1883-1903 years, including Garrison and Franklin (Baptist Hospital).
maps.notes: XYZ/WMTS tiles after a free sign-in.

maps.title: Mississippi River Commission, Survey of the Mississippi River (chart sheets)
maps.use_for: River islands used as fight grounds: Carroll/Foil's Island, Foster's Island, Chouteau Island, Bissell's Point, Quarantine.
maps.holder: University of Illinois Digital Library (also LOC; indexed in the Big Ten Academic Alliance (BTAA) Geoportal)
maps.notes: Which chart sheet covers St. Louis to Alton is still to be found. Island outlines in the 1880s are closer to 1869-1873 than anything modern.

maps.title: Rand McNally / Colton railroad maps of the United States
maps.use_for: National view: rail routes between St. Louis, Cincinnati, Chicago, New Orleans, Kansas City, Pittsburgh, New York.
maps.notes: Some sheets in this series are not lined up yet; check each one.
